description: Content list for scripts/release/New-CodeDocsZip.ps1 -- a code+docs review snapshot of this repo. Paths are repo-relative with forward slashes, enumerated from 'git ls-files' (nothing untracked or gitignored can ever enter). The archive's TREE listing always covers EVERY tracked file (scripts/, ledger/, tests included, by name only); a file's actual bytes are staged into the zip only when it matches a 'contentInclude' pattern and no 'contentExclude' pattern -- exclude always wins. Edit this file to change what ships -- the script itself carries no path knowledge.

contentInclude.note: All production Java + main resources for every module (dsl, kernel, adapters, generator, runtimehost, runtimehost-core, tools, db-history).
JSON Schema contracts: runtime, kernel, generator, authoring.
The 4th model.schema.json mirror (see CLAUDE.md) -- kept so the four copies stay complete.
Built-in packs shipped into every generated app: workspace, identity, project-tracker-demo.
The Python CLI (npdev_cli, npdev_monitor, npdev_explore, npdev_diagram, npdev_engines, migrations, ...). Top level only -- NPDevCli/tests/ is content-excluded, tree-listed only.
npdev_static_pages.py's HTML/CSS/JS templates (control-panel, app-tree, app-tree-v2, agent-prompter, properties, verification).
MCP server for AI authoring. Top level only -- NPDevMcp/tests/ is content-excluded, tree-listed only.
Tauri desktop Manager: Rust src, ui/, capabilities. fixtures/ (tests) and icons/ (binaries) are content-excluded below.

Current, curated docs (index + architecture + maintainers + reference + security + adr + ai + external-ai-review). docs/archive/ and docs/beta/ are content-excluded below -- CLAUDE.md marks both 'historical', narrative only.

contentExclude.note: All Java test sources and test resources in every module -- tree-listed only.
Manager test fixtures (doctor/monitor/explore JSON captures) -- tree-listed only.
Binary PNG/ICO assets -- not code or docs; tree-listed only.
Historical/closed-programme docs (CLAUDE.md: 'read for narrative, never for status') -- tree-listed only.
